limitations: Selected public fields and separately read HTML term examples; not a raw immutable API response. Hourly source updates can shift counts.
Publisher's catalogue search returning any listing does not demonstrate relevant, functional or affordable supply.
The single no-result query resembles a canary label, but its origin and buyer authenticity are unverified; do not label it a proven synthetic test.
Distinct client IPs are not distinct people, businesses or paying buyers; queries may include repeated, automated or seller activity.
No AgentMine sales, customers, customer savings, opt-in RFQ demand or demonstrated willingness to pay are evidenced.
decision: Do not monetize generic Lost Demand Intelligence from raw search counts or no-result flags. Explore source-backed recurring topics only after independently checking actual supplier fit and obtaining consented buyer value/payment evidence.
